analysis.explanation: Mirror M5 reports split_view: status REVOKED to verifier but ISSUED to other clients. Differences show sequence 3 altered and 4 missing for other clients. This indicates M5 is equivocating, presenting divergent histories. The other mirrors (M1-M4) agree on sequence 4, so the anomaly is isolated to M5.
analysis.recommendedAction: Isolate mirror M5, verify its logs, check for tampering, coordinate with operator to restore consistent view. Revoke or replace M5 until consistency is restored.
